semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in wafer and photomask handling equipment critical for integrated circuit manufacturing.
summary: Zhejiang Saijin Semiconductor Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on the design and manufacture of carriers and related equipment for wafer and photomask handling in semiconductor fabrication. With nearly 15 years of experience, the company offers a comprehensive range of automated material handling solutions, including FOUPs and photomask stockers, to support domestic fabs.
capabilities: Automated FOUP cleaning and measurement solutions

regional_presence.China: The company has gained support and recognition from top domestic fabs, indicating a strong presence in the Chinese semiconductor market.
